# Final Implementation Architecture

The Awtsmoos gathers many public worlds into one discoverable sky;
Awtsmoos.com gives each family its own bounded gate, then ordinary links let crawlers travel deeper without asking JavaScript why.

## Discovery topology

`/robots.txt`
→ `/sitemap.xml` sitemap index
→ Heichel / alias / comments / translations / apps / games sitemap families
→ canonical public documents
→ ordinary semantic links among aliases, teachings, comments, replies, translations, apps, and games.

## Alias family

New focused modules under `geelooy/@/seo/`:

- `escape.js` — HTML/XML-safe identity text and encoded paths.
- `aliasData.js` — direct public profile identity plus canonical native comment pointers.
- `aliasPage.js` — SSR profile document with name, bio, canonical metadata, and crawlable comment-contribution links.
- `aliasSitemap.js` — bounded public alias sitemap, sharded by page when necessary.

Rewrite `geelooy/@/_awtsmoos.derech.js` as a small route composer. Preserve the existing browser hydrator after useful SSR exists.

## Comment family

New focused modules under `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/comments/`:

- `commentText.js` — safe complete visible body extraction from content, sections, audio transcript, and links.
- `commentPage.js` — real page for the already-defined canonical URL `/heichelos/:heichel/posts/:post/comments/:comment`.
- `postAnnotations.js` — bounded native comment preview for parent teachings, with canonical links to each comment.
- `commentHtml.js` — recursive semantic rendering shared by post preview and comment page.

New `geelooy/comments/_awtsmoos.derech.js` plus small sitemap modules:

- `/comments/sitemap.xml` indexes per-alias comment sitemap shards.
- `/comments/by-alias/:alias.xml` emits every current native rich-comment URL from the compact alias pointer index.

Replies are independently indexed because every native reply receives its own stable comment ID and pointer.

## Translation family

New `translationPage.js` under Heichel routes renders the existing public `postTranslations()` rows as full semantic English HTML with source Hebrew context and a self canonical.

Public route:

`/heichelos/:heichel/series/:series/post/:post/translations`

A generated static `/translations-sitemap.xml` lists every known imported public translation-post surface from the corpus files.

Parent teachings receive a translation preview/link through `postAnnotations.js`.

## App and game families

Do not rewrite 75 mature interactive applications merely to duplicate catalog prose.

Use the authoritative catalogs to generate:

- `/apps/catalog.html` with all public non-game applications, titles, descriptions, and ordinary links;
- `/apps/sitemap.xml` with every public application URL;
- `/games/catalog.html` with all games, titles, descriptions, and ordinary links;
- `/games/sitemap.xml` with every public game URL.

All 44 non-game application routes and all 31 game routes were proven to exist and already contain document titles. The catalog documents provide the missing centralized semantic descriptions and crawl graph.

## Root sitemap

Rewrite `/sitemap.xml` as a sitemap index referencing:

- `/sitemaps/core.xml`
- `/heichelos/sitemap.xml`
- `/@/sitemap.xml`
- `/comments/sitemap.xml`
- `/translations-sitemap.xml`
- `/apps/sitemap.xml`
- `/games/sitemap.xml`

Rewrite `/robots.txt` to advertise the root sitemap index only plus explicit Allow.

`/sitemaps/core.xml` contains stable public top-level discovery hubs.

## Existing files to rewrite completely

- `geelooy/@/_awtsmoos.derech.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/createRoutes.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/postReader.js`
- `geelooy/heichelos/post/_awtsmoos.post.html`
- `geelooy/robots.txt`
- `geelooy/sitemap.xml`

## Generated outputs / new files

- alias SEO modules;
- comment SEO modules;
- comments sitemap router/modules;
- translation page renderer;
- site-index generator under `geelooy/scripts/seo/`;
- apps/games catalog HTML and sitemap XML;
- translation sitemap XML;
- core sitemap XML;
- focused site-wide SEO tests.

## Safety and performance

- No synchronous whole-site recursive sitemap traversal.
- Public alias enumeration is bounded/paged.
- Comment sitemap work is isolated per alias.
- Parent post comment preview is bounded.
- Full comment bodies remain individually indexable through stable URLs.
- Full translation text is indexable through dedicated translation pages.
- Private/submitted/deleted content is excluded or noindexed.
